en.title: Demonstrations and gatherings in CDMX; collectives announce activities this Sunday, 27 September

en.title: House arrest for Ruffo does not modify criminal process - FGR
en.summary: Mexico's Attorney General clarified that transferring Ernesto Ruffo to house arrest does not alter his ongoing criminal case involving organized crime and fuel theft.

en.title: Tropical Depression Eighteen-E forms off Mexico: which states will it affect and what will its trajectory be?
en.summary: A new tropical depression is expected to bring heavy rains, strong winds and high waves to the states of Oaxaca and Guerrero.

en.title: Ruffo Appel's process does not stop despite house arrest, says FGR; there is "compelling" evidence against him, it states
en.summary: The Attorney General stated that the criminal proceedings against Ruffo remain unchanged given the nature of the charges involving organized crime and illegal hydrocarbon activities.

en.title: Schedule and channels to watch Pumas vs Atlético San Luis LIVE; this Sunday, September 27

en.title: Tropical Depression Dieciocho-E forms off Oaxaca and Guerrero; Hurricane Polo maintains category 3 and threatens Baja California Sur

stories.title: Mora ilumina el debut de Rafa Márquez frente a Colombia

en.summary: Gilberto Mora, a 17-year-old player, scored a goal to help Mexico draw 1-1 against Colombia in Rafael Márquez's first match as national team coach, showcasing young leadership and a passing-focused playing style.

stories.title: España estrena su corona; supera 3-2 a Inglaterra en Liga de Naciones

en.title: Spain debuts as champion; beats England 3-2 in Nations League
en.summary: Spain won 3-2 against England at Wembley Stadium in a European Nations League match, taking the lead in Group C in its first game as world champion.

stories.title: China y EU pactan reducir aranceles y diálogo sobre inteligencia artificial

en.title: China and US agree to reduce tariffs and dialogue on artificial intelligence

stories.title: México envejeció en cinco años y la presión por pagar pensiones apenas comienza

en.title: Mexico aged in five years and pressure to pay pensions is just beginning
en.summary: Mexico's population has aged significantly, with one in six households already receiving pensions. Public spending on pensions is projected to reach 2.5 trillion pesos by 2027.

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days following approval of an agreement, but Trump rejected the proposal.
